head_templates.expansion: τούτος • (toútos) m (feminine τούτη, neuter τούτο) demonstrative determiner

etymology_text: From Byzantine Greek τοῦτος (toûtos), from Ancient Greek οὗτος (hoûtos, “this”).

examples.text: Τούτος εδώ είναι ο αδελφός μου.
examples.roman: Toútos edó eínai o adelfós mou.
examples.translation: This one here is my brother.
examples.english: This one here is my brother.

examples.text: Πέραν τούτου, η ιδέα δεν είχε νόημα.
examples.roman: Péran toútou, i idéa den eíche nóima.
examples.translation: Beyond that, the idea didn't make sense.
examples.english: Beyond that, the idea didn't make sense.

examples.text: Τούτο μόνο σου ζητώ και τίποτε άλλο.
examples.roman: Toúto móno sou zitó kai típote állo.
examples.translation: I ask you only this and nothing else.
examples.english: I ask you only this and nothing else.
